parent_objective: design the promotion/generalization gate for the M1362 alpha 0.1 broad-public-replay-passing candidate
blocked_by: M1367 promotes the active-set branch to a public-base promotion/generalization branch
supersedes: local active-set tuning after broad public replay pass

public_gates: M1368 must not update actor weights
M1368 must not use private holdout
M1368 must design promotion and generalization criteria before any new run
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use private holdout before policy is defined

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: starts the promotion/generalization branch for the M1362 alpha 0.1 broad-public candidate
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, actor-update, replay, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the design uses private holdout before defining policy
stop if the design omits fresh scenario/generalization evidence
stop if the design routes directly to PPO
fallback_plan: if promotion criteria are clear, route to promotion/generalization implementation
if fresh scenario tooling is missing, route to fresh scenario design
if protected diagnostics are ambiguous, route to protected diagnostic audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1367 opens a new branch after broad public replay pass

admission_evidence: M1365 passes broad public replay and behavior diagnostics
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: PPO remains blocked until promotion/generalization route is resolved

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1368 designs promotion/generalization evidence and cannot claim level3 self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: design should keep self-ID evidence separate from broad replay success
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1362 alpha 0.1 candidate and M1365 broad public replay artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If generalization fails later, record the failed distribution before PPO or new active-set tuning.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1362 alpha 0.1 candidate is strong enough to justify a formal promotion/generalization gate design before any PPO or private holdout use.
success_criteria: design keeps PPO blocked until promotion/generalization route is resolved
no training, PPO, replay, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design omits promotion or generalization criteria
design uses private holdout without policy
training, PPO, replay, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1368 passes as a design milestone only if it defines promotion/generalization criteria while keeping training, replay, PPO, private holdout, promotion, and actor-input changes blocked.
